collections.name: Featured
collections.description: What the editors are pointing at this season.

products.title: The Meridian Quarterly — annual membership
products.description: Four printed issues a year, delivered, plus everything on the site and the full archive. The membership that pays a writer to spend a month on an essay and lets us hold it until it is ready. This is how the magazine is funded — there is no advertiser behind it.
products.seoTitle: The Meridian Quarterly — annual print membership
products.seoDescription: Four printed issues a year plus the full archive online. Reader-funded essays, reporting, fiction and criticism.

products.title: The Long View — ten years of The Meridian
products.description: A hardback anthology: thirty of the essays, stories and pieces of reporting that defined the magazine’s first decade, chosen by the editors and introduced by the people who wrote them. 464 pages, sewn binding, made to be kept.
products.seoTitle: The Long View — a ten-year Meridian anthology
products.seoDescription: A hardback anthology of thirty essays, stories and reports from the magazine’s first decade.

images.alt: The Long View, a hardback anthology

products.title: The Fiction Issue — collected
products.description: A slim paperback gathering the best short stories we have published, including three that were never online. A single evening of new fiction, on paper, the way it reads best.
products.seoTitle: The Fiction Issue — collected short stories | The Meridian
products.seoDescription: A paperback of the best short fiction from The Meridian, three of them never published online.

images.alt: The Fiction Issue, a paperback collection

products.title: The Meridian Tote
products.description: A heavyweight natural-canvas tote with the masthead printed small on the side. Sized for a hardback, a notebook, and the two issues you keep meaning to finish.
products.seoTitle: The Meridian Tote — heavyweight canvas tote
products.seoDescription: A heavyweight natural-canvas tote with the Meridian masthead.
